zebra: An animal that somewhat looks like a horse, but has black and white stripes.
We saw zebras while we were in Africa.
By extension, any black and white stripe pattern that looks like a zebra.
I want to paint the room with zebra stripes.
zero: Zero is a count of nothing, the number before one. It is often written 0.
Zero is also used with an uncountable noun.
The symbol for the number zero, that is "0."
The new job added a zero to my pay, from $20,000 to $200,000.
A person or thing that is worth nothing.
I'm not inviting him, he's total zero.
To zero is to make a small change to reset a piece of equipment.
I had to zero the counter on my tape player.
To zero in is to make small changes that bring you closer to something.
I was able to zero in on the source of bad smell in the shed.
zeeshan: Zeeshan is a male given name.
zest: , If you have zest, you are full of excitement or enthusiasm; you are full of life.
, If food has zest, it has a lot of flavor. It might be spicy.
The hot peppers add zest to the soup.
, If music has zest, it is fast and lively.
Play it with more zest this time.
The outer skin of a citrus fruit, used as a flavouring.
If you zest something, you take the zest off of the fruit.
zealand: Zealand is the largest island of Denmark.
Zealand is a province in the Southwestern of the Netherlands.
There are many sights in Zealand.
Zealand is a shortening of New Zealand.
zeshan: Zeshan is a male given name.
zenith: The zenith is the highest point/the tip of something.
After climbing to the zenith of Mount Everest, I was exhausted!
zealander: A Zealander is a resident of (someone who lives in) Zealand.
People who have stayed in Zealand for quite a while are often called Zealanders.
zeal: If someone has zeal, they work very hard at a certain goal.
My brother is training with great zeal – he practices at every spare moment so that he can make the soccer team.
zealot: A zealot is a person with zeal; a person who works very hard towards one goal.
zealous: If somebody is zealous, they are full of zeals; having powerful enthusiasm.
zealously: If something is done zealously, it is done with a powerful enthusiasm; with zeals.
zealousness: Zealousness is a fact of having zeals.
zebu: A zebu is a type of cattle that has a hump on its back native in Asia and Africa.
There was a zebu in the field.
zeroth: Something is zeroth place is in a position that precedes the first.
zesty: If a food is zesty, it has a pungent taste or is full of flavor.
